en.name: Ends the rental bicycle service
en.official: Ordinance to Repeal the Tokyo Metropolitan Taito City Rental Bicycle Ordinance
en.summary: The Taito City Rental Bicycle Ordinance is in place. This bill ends the rental bicycle service and repeals the ordinance. The ordinance will take effect on the date of promulgation.

en.why: The mayor says this is to end the rental bicycle service.
